instruction: Use the Autodesk Fusion 360 GUI in the Manufacture workspace. Open the initial file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\chamfer_plate.step. Create chamfer toolpaths for the top outside contour and all four 6 mm hole mouths. The finished chamfer width must be 0.5 mm and the chamfer path must cover both the outer boundary and every hole opening. Tool definition: T2 is a 90 degree chamfer mill used to cut the required 0.5 mm chamfers. In the NC Program or post-process dialog, use metric units and the selected post processor for this setup, then export C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\task-5.nc to the Desktop path(s) using exactly these absolute file paths.
